# Agenda

- Principles for telling stories visually
- Grammar of Graphics refresher
- Hands-on plots with Laser League players
- Styling tricks (themes, annotations, facetting)

---

# Visualization Goals

- Reveal distribution, comparison, relationship, composition
- Use the right geom for the question
- Keep text + context on the slide (titles, captions!)
- Build plots that we can reuse in homework + final report

---

# Grammar of Graphics

1. **Data** – tidy tibble (e.g., `league_clean`)
2. **Aesthetics** – map variables to `x`, `y`, `color`, `size`
3. **Geoms** – bars, lines, points, boxplots…
4. **Stats** – aggregates (binning, smoothing)
5. **Facets** – small multiples
6. **Theme** – polish + branding

```r
ggplot(data, aes(x = season_score, fill = role)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 50, color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ home_arena)
```

---

# Distribution: Histograms + Density

```r
hist_plot <- league_clean %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = season_score)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 40,
    fill = "#0ef0ff",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = median(league_clean$season_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#ff5ef0"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Season score distribution",
    x = "Score",
    y = "Players"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

- Pair histograms with density curves when helpful
- Always include bin size or reason for the shape

---

# Comparing Groups

```r
box_plot <- league_clean %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = role, y = tag_accuracy_pct, fill = role)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.65) +
  labs(
    title = "Tag accuracy by role",
    x = "Role",
    y = "Tag accuracy (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

- Boxplots highlight spread + outliers quickly
- Consider reordering factors (`fct_reorder`) to story-tell

---

# Relationships + Facets

```r
scatter_plot <- league_clean %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = assists, y = season_score, color = preferred_loadout)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#ff5ef0") +
  facet_wrap(~ home_arena) +
  labs(
    title = "Assists vs score by arena",
    x = "Assists",
    y = "Season score",
    color = "Loadout"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

- Facets surface location effects
- Add trend lines to guide the eye (but mention assumptions)

---

# Styling + Accessibility

- Use `scale_fill_manual()` or `scale_color_brewer()` for palettes
- Large fonts for lecture slides; smaller for handouts
- Add captions describing sample + timeframe
- Use `theme_minimal(base_size = 14)` + `theme(legend.position = "bottom")`
- Export plots as objects for reuse in Quarto/PDF

---

# Lab 03 Expectations

- Deliver at least three polished plots: distribution, comparison, relationship
- Save ggplot objects with descriptive names (`hist_plot`, `box_plot`, `scatter_plot`)
- Mention insight(s) below each plot in the R Markdown narrative
- Knit to HTML/PDF for clarity before uploading to Canvas
